source_title: Nucor Reports Record Annual Earnings for 2018 (Q4 and Full Year 2018 Results)
publisher_issuer: Nucor Corporation (investor press release; corresponds to Form 8-K exhibit, EDGAR CIK 0000073309)
company_context: Nucor is the largest U.S. steel producer, built on an electric-arc-furnace mini-mill model, decentralized operations, scrap recycling, and disciplined capacity management. Its operational excellence and flexible cost structure let it run profitably across steel-price cycles. Fiscal 2018 was a record year, illustrating steady operational management of throughput and cost rather than a rescue.
macro_context: Strong 2018 U.S. steel demand and pricing, aided by Section 232 steel tariffs and robust construction/industrial activity; cyclical industry where capacity utilization and cost discipline determine profitability.
evidence_summary: Nucor's disciplined operational and capacity management converted strong 2018 demand into record results. Consolidated net earnings were $2.36 billion ($7.42 per diluted share), surpassing its prior record of $5.98 per diluted share set in 2008. Consolidated net sales increased 24% to about $25 billion, from $20.25 billion in 2017. Total tons shipped to outside customers were a record 27,899,000, up 5% from 2017, while average sales price per ton rose 18%, and the fourth quarter was the strongest fourth quarter in company history. The record throughput with maintained profitability reflects effective management of production capacity (an operational-bottleneck dimension) rather than a turnaround from distress.

source_backed_metrics.q4_2018_note: strongest fourth quarter in company history

owner_decision_context: Management sustained its long-run model of flexible, low-cost mini-mill production, decentralized accountability, and disciplined capacity utilization, positioning the company to capture favorable demand and pricing without overextending, rather than chasing growth through high fixed-cost expansion.
action_taken: Ran mills at high utilization to a record shipment level while maintaining cost discipline and capturing higher per-ton pricing, consistent with Nucor's established operational-excellence playbook.
outcome_evidence: Record FY2018 net earnings of $2.36B ($7.42 diluted EPS, beating the 2008 record), net sales up 24% to ~$25B, and record shipments of 27,899,000 tons confirm steady, well-managed operational performance.
